Maria Nguyen: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered push of quant profile v1.07 to runtime kernels tonight in EU/US windows. Target start 2026-03-18 02:30 UTC. Owner for each slice?
Alex Chen: I can take slice-A (eu-west). Will do smoke and post logs in this thread. ETA 02:30->03:00 UTC.
Ken Patel: I'll own slice-B (us-east). Prefers burst window 03:05 UTC.
Priya Rao: I'm on CI/rollout watch. I'll confirm the canary results before you move to next slice.
Sam Ortiz: FYI I left a quick CR comment on the rollout doc (CR#452) — small nit about timeout defaults. Can someone address? https://go/reviews/452
Maria Nguyen: great — please run this smoke script and paste exit code + p99 latency.
```bash
./tools/smoke_probe.sh --profile v1.07 --model redwood/compat-1.0 --slice $SLICE
# expected exit 0 and p99 < 150ms
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled job 3601114000 in group rollout-quant-v1.07. Controlled-stagger enabled. :robot_face: 
Alex Chen: smoke done for slice-A. Exit 0. p50 48ms p95 108ms p99 142ms. logs: https://logs/repo/rollouts/3601112222-a
Priya Rao: checked logs — KV cache warmup looks good. minor warning about prefetch but not blocking. :white_check_mark: 
Ken Patel: starting smoke for slice-B now.
Ken Patel: smoke failed on first run, error: "OOM during fused-attn" — retrying with smaller batch.
Sam Ortiz: Ken, paste the exact command + kernel flags you used.
Ken Patel: used --batch 8 --kernel cublas-fused. retesting with --batch 4.
Ken Patel: second run exit 0. p99 180ms. That's above expected. Rolling back slice-B to v1.06 until we investigate. tagging @maria
Maria Nguyen: Ack rollback for slice-B. Ken, open a quick issue with logs and kernel flags so infra can triage tomorrow. Add /cc @alex @priya.
Alex Chen: will hold slice-C until Ken's issue resolved. Good catch.
Priya Rao: adding a temporary fallback policy to the route for slice-B. Done.
Sam Ortiz: CR#452 updated to set timeout to 10s default. @maria can we ship that as follow-up patch?
Maria Nguyen: yes, include it in the post-rollout cleanup. Thanks all. I'll update the runbook with slice owners & the rollback note.
deploy-bot: Rollout group status: slice-A -> v1.07, slice-B -> v1.06 (rolled back), slice-C -> pending. Next check in 20m. :bar_chart:
